title: From Waste to Wow: Recycled Plastics (Grades 4+)
description: Afternoon session, 1pm-4pm, week of 7/6-7/10. Grades 4+. Sort and process plastics, then use injection molding, vacuum forming, and CNC machining to make keychains, pendants, pens, and small containers.

title: The Maplewood Shop — Morning (Grades 3+)
description: Morning session, 9am-12pm, week of 7/6-7/10. Grades 3+. Hand tools, hand-held power tools, and small machines with shop safety — projects include marble run, tool/toy tote, bird feeder, and pucket game. Curriculum from Maplewoodshop.

title: Wood, Tools & Mastery: Build Something Beautiful (Grades 5+)
description: Morning session, 9am-12pm, week of 7/6-7/10. Grades 5+. Real woodshop with proper tool use and shop safety — build a keepsake hardwood box with accurate measuring, clean joinery, and finishing techniques. Small group size for close supervision.

title: YouTube Studio Camp (Grades 3-6)
description: Afternoon session, 1pm-4pm, week of 6/22-6/26. Grades 3-6. Become a YouTube creator — DIYs, parodies, reviews, screencasts, Let's Plays. Custom thumbnails, channel graphics, video editing, lighting, screen capture, special effects, and audio production.

title: Build Your Own Robot (Grades 7+)
description: Build a line-tracking robot and take it home. Learn soldering, electronic parts assembly, light emitters, light sensor circuitry, and tracking memory. Morning session, 9am-12pm, week of 6/22-6/26. Grades 7+.

title: Aquaponics Camp (Grades 3+)
description: Build and take home a functional aquaponics system (with live goldfish) to grow plants using fish waste. Topics include fish and plant life, water physics, and wetland ecosystems. Requires one power outlet. Afternoon session, 1pm-4pm, week of 7/13-7/17. Grades 3+.

title: Advanced LEGO Robotics (Grades 6+)
description: Uses the LEGO EV3 platform for open-ended challenges from past state competitions. Pairs work through programming and mechanical challenges, culminating in a shared final-exam challenge on Friday. Afternoon session, 1pm-4pm, week of 7/13-7/17. Grades 6+.

title: Art Camp (Preschool Express)
location: Millersville Community Church, 163 W Frederick St
description: Week 4 of Preschool Express's summer camps, with Mrs. Jones and Miss Michele. A week of hands-on art — paint, clay, markers, even tie-dye — plus art at snack time. Runs Mon–Thu, June 15–18, 9am–noon. $120 for the week (materials included); 15% off when you register for two or more camps, and a $25 deposit holds each spot. Open to preschoolers plus K–2 family and friends; campers must be potty trained. Registration form (PDF) and details on the Preschool Express site.

title: Music Camp (Preschool Express)
location: Millersville Community Church, 163 W Frederick St
description: Week 5 of Preschool Express's summer camps, with Mrs. Jones and Miss Deb. A week of music, movement, instruments, rhythm games, crafts, and snacks, exploring ideas like fast/slow and high/low. Runs Mon–Thu, June 22–25, 9am–noon. $120 for the week (materials included); 15% off when you register for two or more camps, and a $25 deposit holds each spot. Open to preschoolers plus K–2 family and friends; campers must be potty trained. Registration form (PDF) and details on the Preschool Express site.
